title: Starbucks 20 oz White Stainless Steel Tumbler Mermaid 2018 No Lid - See Pics
descriptionText:
No lid. Minor scratches. Dent on bottom. See the pictures.

This Starbucks tumbler is a must-have for any coffee and tea lover! With a capacity of 20 oz, it is perfect for your on-the-go caffeine fix. The white stainless steel material gives it a sleek and original look, while the mermaid design adds a touch of charm. 

Made in China and an original Starbucks product, this tumbler is perfect for collectors and fans alike. Whether you use it for your morning coffee or as a decorative piece, this tumbler is sure to impress. Get yours now and enjoy your favorite beverage in style!
